Itemized Passive Description:
*Activates the Entrance Animation when 6 or more Super Class allies
are on the team upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}Randomly changes Ki Spheres of a certain Type
(PHY excluded) to PHY Ki Spheres, chance of evading enemy's
attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g} and launches an additional Super Attack for 6 turns
- {passiveImg:once}Damage reduction rate 50%{passiveImg:up_g} for 1 turn
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +2 and ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Medium chance of evading enemy's attack
*When attacking*
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
*3 or more Ki Spheres obtained, or 2 or more Ki Spheres obtained
as the 3rd attacker in a turn*
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
*6 or more Ki Spheres obtained, or 4 or more Ki Spheres obtained
as the 3rd attacker in a turn*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Guards all attacks
- Super Class allies' Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}, plus an additional
Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g} and attacks are effective against all Types
for characters who also belong to the "Realm of Gods" Category
*After performing 4 Super Attacks in battle*
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g} and chance of evading enemy's attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
